about: cc5 design frames for the Stage 6 LCD harness, generated by tests/tools/make_cc5_frames.py from tests/fixtures/knob_golden.json (knob-model.js). Each frame is the presentation-4 wire frame (control_center.device._frame output, slimmed), ledStyle 'color'. 'art' names the fixture in assets/fixtures/<art>.rgb565 to load for the frame's artKey.
valueNote: value carries the volume digits plus '%' (contract section 3 example '54%'); Knob Face draws the '%' at 22 px in ink2 after the 48 px digits.

deviations.6: Tracks with no Previous: title 'Previous track' (muted), meta 'Previous unavailable'.
deviations.7: Art does not translate on a screen change; no decorative scale transforms.
deviations.8: Disconnected: no frame (native handback); cases keep frame null.
